// Prepare metadata for manual approval
const videoData = $input.first().json;

const approvalRequest = {
  approval_id: `approval-${videoData.script_id}-${Date.now()}`,
  script_id: videoData.script_id,
  created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(),
  
  video_content: {
    title: videoData.title,
    description: videoData.description,
    duration_seconds: videoData.long_form_video.duration_seconds || 0,
    video_url: videoData.long_form_video.url,
    format: 'MP4'
  },
  
  metadata: {
    tags: videoData.tags || [],
    category_id: videoData.category_id,
    category_name: getCategoryName(videoData.category_id),
    language: videoData.language || 'en',
    default_language: videoData.default_language || 'en',
    keywords: videoData.keywords || []
  },
  
  privacy: {
    status: videoData.privacy_status || 'private',
    embeddable: videoData.embeddable !== false,
    allow_comments: videoData.allow_comments !== false,
    allow_ratings: videoData.allow_ratings !== false,
    made_for_kids: videoData.made_for_kids === true
  },
  
  shorts_available: !!videoData.shorts_video,
  long_form_available: !!videoData.long_form_video,
  
  approval_status: 'pending',
  approver: null,
  approval_decision: null,
  approval_timestamp: null,
  approval_comments: ''
};

function getCategoryName(categoryId) {
  const categories = {
    '1': 'Film & Animation',
    '2': 'Autos & Vehicles',
    '10': 'Music',
    '15': 'Pets & Animals',
    '17': 'Sports',
    '18': 'Short Movies',
    '19': 'Travel & Events',
    '20': 'Gaming',
    '21': 'Videoblogging',
    '22': 'People & Blogs',
    '23': 'Comedy',
    '24': 'Entertainment',
    '25': 'News & Politics',
    '26': 'Howto & Style',
    '27': 'Education',
    '28': 'Science & Technology',
    '29': 'Nonprofits & Activism',
    '30': 'Movies',
    '31': 'Anime/Animation',
    '32': 'Action/Adventure',
    '33': 'Classics',
    '34': 'Comedies',
    '35': 'Documentaries',
    '36': 'Dramas',
    '37': 'Family',
    '38': 'Foreign',
    '39': 'Horror',
    '40': 'Sci-Fi/Fantasy',
    '41': 'Thrillers',
    '44': 'Shorts',
    '52': 'Trailers',
    '53': 'Shows',
    '54': 'Trailers'
  };
  return categories[categoryId] || 'Unknown';
}

return approvalRequest;
